description:
Dear Influencer,

I hope this finds you well. I'm reaching out on behalf of Cycolinks, a leading brand specializing in biker gifts and jewelry. 

Brand Introduction:
Cycolinks is a renowned brand dedicated to catering to the biking community's passion for unique and stylish accessories. We offer a diverse range of high-quality biker gifts and jewelry that are designed to reflect the spirit of adventure and freedom on any form of two wheels.

Product Description:
Our collection includes a wide array of meticulously crafted items, including personalized gifts, pendants, bracelets, rings, and more. Each piece is thoughtfully designed to capture the essence of the biker lifestyle, blending contemporary aesthetics with the rugged charm of the open road.

USP (Unique Selling Point):
What sets Cycolinks apart is our unwavering commitment to craftsmanship, quality, and attention to detail. Our products are made with premium materials and undergo rigorous quality checks to ensure they meet the highest standards. Moreover, we take pride in our ability to offer customizable options, allowing bikers to express their unique style and individuality.

Payment Terms:
We value the contributions of our influencers and believe in fair compensation for their efforts. As part of our collaboration, we offer competitive commission rates and flexible payment terms. We can discuss further details and negotiate a mutually beneficial arrangement based on your preferences and performance.

Other Information:
Cycolinks is dedicated to fostering long-term partnerships with influencers who share our passion for biking and can authentically connect with their audience. We are committed to providing you with all the necessary support, including access to exclusive promotions, special discounts, and personalized affiliate links to track your referrals effectively.

We would be thrilled to have you join our team of brand ambassadors and showcase our exceptional products to your engaged audience of biking enthusiasts.

If you're interested in collaborating with us, please let us know, and we can discuss the details further.

Thank you for considering this opportunity. We look forward to potentially embarking on an exciting partnership!

Best regards,

Neil
Cycolinks

term_and_condition:
Cycolinks Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Last Updated: [Insert Date]

1. Overview

By joining the Cycolinks Affiliate Program, you agree to promote our brand in a fair, ethical, and transparent way. These terms are designed to protect both Cycolinks and our affiliates while ensuring high-quality traffic and long-term growth.

We reserve the right to approve, reject, or remove affiliates at our discretion.

2. Approved Promotion Methods

Affiliates are welcome to promote Cycolinks using:

  • Personal websites or blogs

  • Social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)

  • Email marketing (to opt-in audiences only)

  • Genuine content creation (reviews, styling, lifestyle content)

All promotion must be authentic and add value.

3. Strictly Prohibited Activities

The following activities are NOT allowed and will result in immediate removal and forfeiture of commissions:

3.1 Brand Bidding (Paid Ads)

Affiliates may NOT run paid ads targeting:

  • “Cycolinks”

  • “Cycolinks.com”

  • Any variation, misspelling, or branded keyword

This includes:

  • Google Ads

  • Bing Ads

  • TikTok Ads

  • Facebook Ads

  • Any paid search or display platform

3.2 Coupon & Discount Abuse

Affiliates may NOT:

  • Promote Cycolinks on coupon or deal websites without permission

  • Use publicly available discount codes to claim commission

  • Mislead customers with fake or expired discounts

Only official affiliate-issued codes may be used.

3.3 Traffic Hijacking

Affiliates may NOT:

  • Intercept or redirect traffic that would otherwise come directly to Cycolinks

  • Use browser extensions, popups, or forced redirects

  • Engage in cookie stuffing or tracking manipulation

3.4 Misrepresentation

Affiliates may NOT:

  • Pretend to be Cycolinks or represent themselves as the brand

  • Use our branding, logos, or identity in a misleading way

  • Claim false partnerships or ownership

3.5 Low-Quality or Spam Traffic

Prohibited sources include:

  • Spam emails or messages

  • Fake accounts or bot traffic

  • Incentivized or misleading clicks

  • Arbitrage traffic with no genuine user intent

4. Commission Rules

  • Commission is paid only on valid, genuine customer purchases

  • We reserve the right to:

    • Reject suspicious or low-quality orders

    • Reverse commissions linked to prohibited activity

  • No commission will be paid on:

    • Self-purchases

    • Refunded or cancelled orders

    • Orders generated via prohibited methods

5. Affiliate Approval & Monitoring

  • All affiliates are subject to manual review

  • We may request:

    • Your promotion methods

    • Links to your content or platforms

  • Accounts may be:

    • Suspended

    • Restricted

    • Removed

At any time without prior notice if violations are suspected.

6. Payment Terms

  • Payments are issued once:

    • Minimum thresholds are met

    • Orders are confirmed (no refunds/chargebacks)

  • Payment timing may vary depending on performance and verification checks

  • Commission payouts below the $50 USD threshold will remain pending until the minimum amount is reached.

7. Termination

Cycolinks reserves the right to:

  • Terminate any affiliate account at any time

  • Cancel unpaid commissions if terms are violated

8. Updates to Terms

We may update these terms at any time. Continued participation in the program means you accept any updated terms.

9. Our Approach

We value affiliates who:

  • Build genuine audiences

  • Create real content

  • Add value to the biker community

Our goal is long-term partnerships — not short-term exploitation of the system.

10. Contact

For questions or partnership opportunities, contact:
info@cycolinks.com

Ride with integrity — and we’ll build something great together. 🚴
